clips.title: The story
paras: Keryn Sylvius sends a sealed parcel from Goldshire to Master Mathias Shaw in Stormwind. The delivery gives a promising rogue entry into SI:7's inner workings.

A parcel from the Lion's Pride Inn to the Stormwind Barracks may look like ordinary courier work. For a budding rogue, it is an audition for Stormwind Intelligence. Local trainer Keryn Sylvius entrusts the package to novice cutpurses, giving them a direct introduction to Master Mathias Shaw. The delivery tests whether they can cross the capital quietly, keep a low profile, and follow discreet orders without asking questions.

The handoff brings an operative into SI:7 headquarters in Old Town. Mathias Shaw uses such deliveries to separate pretenders from true talents. Those who present the parcel without faltering receive high-stakes field assignments, beginning with covert reconnaissance and infiltration against Defias smuggling networks in Elwynn Forest.
